title: Portland Schooner Co.
specs: Historic wooden schooners, some over 100 years old and on the National Register of Historic Places
Sailing in calm waters of Casco Bay with views of lighthouses, seals, seabirds, and historic forts
No minimum age for sailing; children must be supervised
All passengers including infants require tickets per Coast Guard regulations
Boat capacities range from 6 to 49 guests depending on vessel
Private charters available for groups from 6 to 49 guests

blurb: Guests sail on classic wooden windjammers or cruise on a historic motorboat along the rugged coastline of Casco Bay. The sails last two hours and the lighthouse cruises last 1.5 hours. All ages are welcome and guests can bring food and drink aboard.
extraNote: Tickets are nonrefundable unless cancelled by operator due to weather or other circumstances · Guests can exchange tickets to another day depending on availability · Sails go out in light drizzle or passing showers; cancellation only in downpour · Gratuity customary at 15-20% · Arrive at least 15 minutes before scheduled departure · Primary dock house on the Maine State Pier past the Casco Bay Lines ferry terminal; secondary dock house at Ocean Gateway next to the Visitors Center and across from the AC Hotel on Thames Street. · May-October
